# 🏆 The Skill Cup

<!-- Generated by scripts/close-skill-cup.mjs from data/skill-cup.json; do not edit by hand. -->

A monthly contest for the best new skill on a theme. Write one skill on the month's theme, open a pull request, and it is scored the same way the library scores itself: it must pass SkillSpec L3, then it runs on its own eval cases and a pinned judge scores the output, blind, on a 1–5 rubric. The top score at the end of the month wins a permanent line below, a winner badge on the skill's page, and first pick of a future theme. There is no prize money yet; if you would like to sponsor one, open an issue.

## This month: Health paperwork (2026-10-11 → 2026-10-31)

Skills that help people read, check and act on medical letters, bills, test results and insurance forms.

**To enter:** add `skills/<your-skill>/SKILL.md` and at least one eval case for it in `evals/cases.json`, in one pull request with `[Cup]` in the title. A maintainer runs the scoring; the result is posted on the PR. Check your skill first with `npx skillspec-check skills/<your-skill>`.

No entries yet. The first one sets the bar.
